base.purpose: Inherited host font at keyword size small; buttons and menu items.

title.purpose: Toolbar title and grid value, weight 600.

label.purpose: Bar numbers, track names, badge, readout chip, 0.92em with tabular numerals.

numeral-label.purpose: Octave labels in the pitch column, 0.85em.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: The grid popover in the top layer.

shadows.name: selected-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Spread ring on a note that is both selected and keyboard-focused.

motion.name: note-opacity
motion.purpose: Note dimming for the blocked-drop cue; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Grid Button
components.description: Toolbar button that opens the grid popover.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 28%, #ffffff); border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: #18181b; font: inherit; font-size: small; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button b { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; } .ds-chev { width: 5px; height: 5px; margin-top: -3px; border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 6%, #ffffff); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2457d6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Read-only Badge
components.description: Pill at the end of the toolbar when the editor is not editable.
components.css: .ds-badge { padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 28%, #ffffff); border-radius: 999px; color: color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 66%, #ffffff); font-size: 0.92em; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Note
components.description: One note: a block one row high. Shown selected.
components.css: .ds-note { box-sizing: border-box; height: 14px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 30%, #2457d6); border-radius: 3px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #2457d6 72%, #18181b); outline: 2px solid #18181b; outline-offset: 1px; cursor: grab; } .ds-note:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #2457d6; }

components.name: Blocked Note
components.description: Blocked-drop cue: dashed outline and dimmed.
components.css: .ds-note-blocked { box-sizing: border-box; height: 14px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 30%, #2457d6); border-radius: 3px; background: #2457d6; opacity: 0.45; outline: 2px dashed #18181b; transition: opacity 120ms ease-out; }

components.name: Readout Chip
components.description: The one authored move: inverted chip that follows the pointer during a drag.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #18181b; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.92em; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Menu Item
components.description: Radio item in the grid popover; the dot marks the checked one.
components.css: .ds-menu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 190px; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 10px 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; font-size: small; text-align: start; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dot { flex: none; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2457d6; } .ds-menu-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 8%, transparent); } .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2457d6; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The editor has no brand. It takes the look of its host through the public theme variables and ships only neutral defaults. It is an Operate surface following DAW conventions, with touch and keyboard first-class. The readout chip is its one authored move.
keyCharacteristics: No identity of its own: colours and type come from the host; defaults are neutral.
Hairline structure: 1px lines, tonal fills, almost no shadow.
Two densities selected by pointer type, not by screen width.
Every state is visible without colour alone: selection adds an outline, a blocked drop is dashed and dimmed.
Fully isolated styles: the host cannot restyle the editor by accident.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: The package never names a colour outside the variable contract and its neutral defaults.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent marks focus and the checked menu dot; the note colour defaults to the same value. Nothing else is tinted.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change uses lining, tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Keyword Size Rule
rules.body: No px or rem font sizes. The root is a keyword; descendants are em.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Moved Rule
rules.body: A note has no shadow at rest. It gains one only while dragged.

dos: Do take every colour from the theme variable contract or a color-mix of bg and text.
Do keep the neutral defaults described as defaults, and keep hosts' mapping optional.
Do size type with small at the root and em below, and use tabular lining numerals for any number.
Do give every new interactive element a 2px accent outline with 2px offset on :focus-visible, and a coarse-pointer size.
Do show a state with a shape or outline in addition to colour.
Do put any new floating layer in a native popover so it reaches the top layer.
Do prefix every class with sce-, inject styles once per container, and release them on destroy.
donts: Don't state a brand: no fixed brand colour, no bundled font, no logo.
Don't hard-code px or rem font sizes, or a font family other than through --sce-font-family.
Don't add decoration or motion beyond the 120ms note opacity transition.
Don't rely on a host's cascade: keep the all: initial root, the all: revert descendants under the doubled class, and the hand-reset exception for notes.
Don't publish or depend on --sce-_* variables outside the stylesheet.
Don't import styles as a CSS file or leave nodes behind.
